**PROVEN** · **PARTIALLY PROVEN** · **UNPROVEN** · **REFUTED**. Each with **"What would falsify this"** + whether attempted.

=== CLAIMS TO TEST ===

**C24.** Exactly 12 of the changed paths are Tier 1 per BASE `.claude/rules/frozenFiles.md` + BASE `CODEOWNERS`. Recount INDEPENDENTLY at live head (the file set may have changed since 74e2b82 — verify the changed-file list at `5fe247c` first). Report your own number; if it differs from 12, say so.

**C25.** `package.json` at `pr/61-live` adds exactly one dependency, `@vitest/coverage-v8` (devDependency), and there is NO evidence of integration-team approval in the PR body, any commit message, or PR comments. AGENTS.md Hard Rule 7 requires that approval. Also: `vitest.config.ts` is modified, and AGENTS.md Hard Rule 8 names it as never-modify. Verify both, and search the PR body + all commits + all PR comments for approval evidence (state search scope inline).
**Attack it:** does the repo have any precedent/exception mechanism? Does AGENTS.md's "verified-session exception" apply here? Check whether the PR author is in `@ZimmermannAU/tier-1-approvers` via `gh api orgs/ZimmermannAU/teams/tier-1-approvers/members` — that changes whether pause-points were owed.

**C26 — INDEPENDENTLY RE-DERIVE, do not trust my method.**
Claim: under BASE `qa.yml` logic the unscopable-diff fallback was `e2e_scope=full`; under this PR it is `skip`; and `tj-actions/changed-files` is configured to diff against the PREVIOUS PUSH (not the merge-base). Therefore, for 20 of the 21 commits on this branch, `Playwright E2E (localhost)` would have RUN under base logic and SKIPS under this PR's logic — i.e. the skip is caused by the PR's own change, not by "nothing relevant changed".
Re-derive this yourself: read the `files_yaml` groups and the scope-resolution shell at BOTH base and live head, work out the rule, then compute per-commit. **Report your own numbers.** If you get something other than 20/21, say so loudly.
Then answer separately: **is the counterfactual fair?** Many of those commits are e2e-relevant only because `qa.yml`/`browserstack.yml`/`computeBuildName.mjs` are themselves in the `e2e` group — so under base logic, editing a CI file triggered a full browser suite. Assess whether the author's change is a reasonable fix for genuine over-triggering, and whether "the skip was caused by the PR" is a fair characterisation or a misleading one.

**C27.** `e2e-browserstack-preview.yml` at live head gates its BrowserStack run on the `.e2e` field of the artifact, NOT on `.e2e_scope`. Consequence: a PR where `e2e=true` but `e2e_scope=skip` gets NO localhost E2E but DOES proceed to the BrowserStack step. Verify the exact jq expression and the gate chain.

**C28.** The ticket's Deliverable 1 (a spec at `e2e/tests/zimm/integrations/SFCC-420-global-e-job-site-assignments.p1.spec.ts`, Zephyr key `SFCC-T150`, 6 BDD scenarios, tags `@SFCC-420 @global-e @integration @p1`) was NOT delivered; `SFCC-T150`/`SFCC-420` appear at live head only inside `.docs/temp/` markdown. The substitution IS documented and reasoned in `.docs/temp/SFCC-751-implementation-spec.md` (SFCC-420's work lives in the `zimmermann-sfcc` repo and already shipped). Verify all parts, state search scope inline. Judge whether "not delivered" or "deliberately substituted with recorded rationale" is the accurate characterisation.

**C29.** Deliverable 3 (end-to-end validation) has no evidence: the BrowserStack job has 0 successes across all runs on this branch, and both new workflows are not registered on the default branch (so `workflow_run` cannot fire pre-merge). Verify independently via `gh api .../actions/workflows` and `gh api .../actions/runs?branch=feature/browserstack-ci-automation`. **Enumerate the actual run conclusions yourself** — report your own counts by identity (commit SHAs), not just totals.

**C30.** Deliverable 2 requires attaching a HAR to the Zephyr execution record. No HAR handling exists anywhere at live head. State search scope inline (include `recordHar`, `record_har`, `.har`, `harPath`).

**C31.** `.github/workflows/protected-file-guard.yml` contains no `browserstack` entry at BASE or at live head, so the tier guard is blind to that Tier 1 file even though this PR renames it, re-asserts its Tier 1 status in `frozenFiles.md`, routes it in `CODEOWNERS`, and restructures the guard itself.

Per claim: verdict, exact evidence, "what would falsify this", whether attempted, corrected wording if PARTIALLY PROVEN. Flag explicitly any claim where the FACT is true but my CHARACTERISATION is unfair to the author — I would rather drop a finding than post an unfair one.
